traceDiagram.title: Team page flow diagram
traceDiagram.description: This diagram shows how the team page loads a trainer through `useTrainer()`, watches the events of the team and renders the team of that trainer. It also shows what happens when the user publishes the team, and how the request reaches the API through `publishTeam()`.

traceNodes.label: Loads one trainer by its id
traceNodes.description: When the user opens the app, [`TeamPage` calls this hook with `trainerId` 1](code:src/pages/team/TeamPage.tsx#L18). After the first render, React runs [the effect of the hook](code:src/hooks/use-trainer.ts#L8-10), and the effect calls `request()` with `/trainers/1`.

Returns the loaded trainer, or null until it loads
